Silicon Box Ships 500M Units at High Yield, Expands Production Capacity for Panel-Level Packaging

Silicon Box addresses performance, scalability and cost challenges in wafer-level and monolithic chip architectures by enabling chiplet-based semiconductors on a large panel-level manufacturing scheme. The company is the only advanced packaging provider producing exclusively at panel-scale with commercially viable yields.

Early customers across a broad range of device applications from multi-chip AI training products to simple devices requiring fast production ramp up and massive scale are already taking advantage of Silicon Box’s technology, proving the long-conjectured value propositions associated with panel-level packaging and a chiplet approach to chip system design.

Record-Breaking Yield and Factory Progress

One of the more remarkable aspects of Silicon Box’s 100-million-unit shipment milestone, is that the production facility has exceeded co-founder and CEO, Dr. BJ Han, and his technical leadership team’s long term track record for industry leading yield which was 99.7% at wafer scale.

The Tampines factory had its grand opening in July 2023, with mass production starting later that year. In 2024, the facility achieved ISO 9001:2015 certification, followed by ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certifications in 2025. These certifications underscore Silicon Box’s commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, employee well-being and sustainability management, respectively.

Silicon Box's 100-million-unit production milestone demonstrates that the company is on track to achieve its capacity and production targets at its flagship facility, with full capacity installation expected by 2028. Meanwhile, the
company’s second manufacturing facility, to be located in Novara, Piedmont, Italy, is expected to begin production in 2028.

The planned site which is larger than Singapore is expected to replicate production capacity and bring native test capability to Europe. The new plant will establish a full semiconductor value chain from design to final manufacturing and test, to serve sectors such as artificial intelligence (AI), high-performance computing (HPC), automotive, mobile, Internet of Things, and robotics.

“At the same time, the benefits of our solutions and the economics of our large-format manufacturing scheme allow a broader range of customers and device applications to reap the benefits of the most advanced packaging methods. 1. 前提：Silicon Boxとは何者か
まず全体像を押さえておきます。Silicon Boxは2021年にシンガポールで創業したスタートアップで、創業者はMarvell共同創業者のBJ Han氏、故Sehat Sutardja氏、Weili Dai氏という半導体パッケージング分野の重鎮です。同社の中核技術は
パネルレベルパッケージング（PLP）とチップレット統合（SiPlet®）
という「後工程（バックエンド／BEOL）」に特化したファウンドリです。
ここが重要な論点です。世間の注目は前工程（TSMCのような回路形成の微細化）に集まりがちですが、Silicon Boxが賭けているのは
「微細化が物理・経済の限界に近づく中、性能・コスト・スケーラビリティの突破口は後工程のパッケージング（複数のチップレットを高密度に統合する技術）に移る」

1. 전제: Silicon Box란 무엇인가
먼저 전체적인 모습을 파악해 보겠습니다. Silicon Box는 2021년 싱가포르에서 창업한 스타트업으로, 창업자는 Marvell 공동 창업자인 BJ Han, 고(故) Sehat Sutardja, Weili Dai 등 반도체 패키징 분야의 거물들입니다. 동사의 핵심 기술은
패널 레벨 패키징(PLP)과 칩렛 통합(SiPlet®)
이라는 '후공정(백엔드/BEOL)'에 특화된 파운드리입니다.
여기가 중요한 논점입니다. 세상의 주목은 전공정(TSMC와 같은 회로 형성의 미세화)에 쏠리기 쉽지만, Silicon Box가 베팅하고 있는 것은
미세화가 물리적·경제적 한계에 다다르는 가운데, 성능·비용·확장성의 돌파구는 후공정 패키징(여러 칩렛을 고밀도로 통합하는 기술)으로 옮겨간다

1. Premise: Who is Silicon Box?

First, let's grasp the big picture. Silicon Box is a startup founded in Singapore in 2021 by heavyweights in the semiconductor packaging field: Marvell co-founder BJ Han, the late Sehat Sutardja, and Weili Dai. The company's core technology is a foundry specializing in "back-end (BEOL)" processes, specifically
Panel Level Packaging (PLP) and Chiplet Integration (SiPlet®)
This is a key point. While public attention tends to focus on front-end processes (miniaturization of circuit formation like TSMC), Silicon Box is betting on a shift in industrial structure:

"As miniaturization approaches physical and economic limits, the breakthrough for performance, cost, and scalability is shifting to back-end packaging (technology that integrates multiple chiplets at high density)."
The surge in demand for AI/HPC is fueling this, and in fact, the flagship Singapore factory has shipped over 250 million units cumulatively as of Q1 2026 with near-perfect yields.
